import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='tests/codegen/php_tags.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    // A file may OPEN with one.
    let opens = compile_and_run("<?= 1 + 2 ?>\\n<?php echo \\"!\\\\n\\";\\n");
    assert_eq!(opens, "3\\n!\\n");'''
new='''    // A file may OPEN with one. The `?>` still swallows the newline after it, so nothing
    // separates the two outputs.
    let opens = compile_and_run("<?= 1 + 2 ?>\\n<?php echo \\"!\\\\n\\";\\n");
    assert_eq!(opens, "3!\\n");'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('expectation corrected from php')
